text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Victoire Pisa invited me 
to go stargazing together.
choice_data_list: Is the stargazing spot just up ahead?
Is the stargazing spot just up ahead?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The air is so clear that you can see 
stars you could never see from the 
academy.

—The universe is 'M.F.T.' Coordinates are 
indeterminate... A 'new discovery,' 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san...! Could it be you're here 
for stargazing too?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, would you gaze at the 
stars with me? ...Just like we always do.
choice_data_list: Do you two go stargazing together often?
Do you two go stargazing together often?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. It's more like... we often bump 
into each other by coincidence and end up 
doing so.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Encountering" her feels like 
"gravitational pull." When Victoire Pisa 
is around... it feels all "warm and 
toasty."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad to hear that♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... Universe-san was 
the reason I first became interested in 
the starry sky, wasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—“Transmission” is “loud and clear.” 
...Dit, dah, dah...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, Universe-san. ...Umm, what 
are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "CETI"... This is "communication."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Contact"—...In other words, a message to 
someone, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. To bridge the 
"disconnection"... We must "connect" with 
outer space, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
..."Connect". Does that, by any chance... 
mean to connect?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: With someone... beyond this starry sky...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Neo Universe is "JEM"... In 
other words, "believing."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... it's wonderful, isn't it? To think 
that somewhere among these stars, there is 
"someone" we can connect with.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Um, would it be alright if I sat next to 
you? I want to hear... more of your 
stories.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. We've looked up at the starry sky 
together so many times since then, haven't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe will synchronize. The 
"probe" will be done together, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa and the others enjoyed 
nature until sunset, and then headed 
toward their destination. ...And then—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Look. It's shining so 
brightly...
choice_data_list:
You're right! To think it's this 
beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... That star— Then if I connect that 
star to that one... Hehe, should we name 
it... the "Donut Constellation"?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... It's, well, an original 
constellation. A game Universe and I often 
play when stargazing... if you will.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. “Connecting” star to star... 
Its subject is “loneliness”.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's a solitary star that isn't connected 
to any constellation. ...I just thought, 
even if it's lonely, maybe turning it into 
a constellation would make it feel less 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... But who knows, maybe it only looks 
that way from Earth, and there are 
actually lots of aliens there, so it isn't 
lonely at all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That would be much more wonderful, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yet, what if—what if somewhere in this 
vast universe, there truly is a solitary 
"someone" out there—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I still want to connect with others. I 
want to stand beside them. Just like 
connecting the stars.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—That is "Elpis." Victoire Pisa's universe 
is... "warm," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...! Where am I—!?
choice_data_list:
I was in the mountains just a moment 
ago...?!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Observe." At those coordinates lies the 
"Marigold Constellation"... do you 
remember?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That is... yes, of course. Because it's a 
constellation that I created.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Over there is the Ladybug constellation. 
And the Strawberry constellation too...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? This is "DPSE"— 
Victoire Pisa's "inner space."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "severance" of the universe is 
absolute, and "solitudes" exist without 
number... Yet even so, you wished to 
"connect."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This universe is full of brilliance— It's 
"sparkling," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...! Universe-san...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
With that 'kindness,' I'm sure... you can 
'connect' even with the 'far reaches of 
the universe.'

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. If that is so— allow me to offer 
you my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even the loneliness of countless eons 
could be filled. ...The one who showed me 
that possibility was――

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Neo Universe. Because... you are you."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for sharing your wonderful 
universe, Universe. Those stars were... 
so, so beautiful.
choice_data_list:
Now I want to try connecting the stars 
too.
I want to try connecting the stars too!
Maybe Neo Universe is your teacher
Maybe Neo Universe is your teacher

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you too, Trainer...! Fufu, yes. Let's 
definitely draw together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe made a 『Discovery』. That 
star... is 『a lonely one』, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Then if we're connecting them... maybe 
that star?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. It looks like it'll be a 
massive constellation... What should we 
name it? Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps that's true. 
...Universe-san. May I continue to gaze at 
the stars together with you...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. A "rendezvous" with Victoire 
Pisa... That is very "calming."
